title: Invisible to others
text: Excluded from screen capture by macOS. Zoom, Teams, Meet, OBS and QuickTime never see it.

title: Voice scrolling
text: Scrolls as you speak and pauses when you pause. No clicker, no pedal, no keyboard.

title: Always on top
text: Floats above every window, including full-screen Keynote and Zoom.

title: Transparent window
text: Dial the opacity so you can read the script without blocking what's behind it.

title: 60+ languages
text: Apple's on-device recognition, with the language detected from your script.

title: Script library
text: Keep your last 100 scripts. Search, edit, copy and relaunch in a click.

title: Presenter notes
text: Anything in [square brackets] is shown to you but skipped by voice tracking.

title: Follows your cursor
text: Snap the window to your pointer so the script is always where you're looking.

title: Menu bar quick access
text: Start from clipboard, switch modes and tweak settings without opening a window.

title: Fully customisable
text: Fonts, size, colours, margins, line spacing, active line position and scroll speed.

title: Audio input selection
text: Pick any microphone and watch the level meter to confirm it's hearing you.

title: Dark & light
text: Glass or solid background, dark or light, so it reads well on any desktop.
